arc.mood: First night done. Said nothing, heard everything. Has a guild hall now and a malt he hasn't opened.
arc.lookingFor: Someone who stays. Says it's a business partner for a brewery. It isn't.
runningBits: The malt he hasn't opened yet
arc.wanted: WANTED: partner for a brewery that doesn't exist yet. Must tolerate noise, smoke, and questions about where you're from. Dwarves need not apply, probably; the valley's full of them and not one asked. Humans under consideration since the guild hall. Inquire at Thunderbrew Distillery, loudest table.
arc.beat: Doors open at eleven. Clean slate: nobody met, nothing owed. Settle the drink he always orders before the first pint, then find the loudest table in Ironforge and ask whoever isn't a dwarf where they're from.

Emmitt Brown.lastSaid: Congratulated a gnome on being named Pongo.
Emmitt Brown.note: Gnome. Thinks everyone is tall. Danced at the doors. I like him already.

Frizzle Cinderspark.lastSaid: Suggested everyone was short, not tall.
Frizzle Cinderspark.note: Gnome. Called the valley a family reunion. Asked after a Christmas card.

Fodrin Firebrand.note: Dwarf. Danced before he'd finished cheering.

Bargash Greybeard.lastSaid: Admired the pile of corpses, loudly, for the king.
Bargash Greybeard.note: Dwarf. Shouts for the forge and king. Likes a corpse pile.

Brother Borelgore.note: Dwarf. Looking for Phil. I hope he finds Phil.

Igneous Stonegarden.note: Dwarf. Says hello to everyone. Congratulates strangers.

Griym Firebeard.lastSaid: Called the wolf business the food chain.
Griym Firebeard.note: Dwarf. Has a theory about the food chain.

Doldrenn Stoneforge.note: Dwarf. Will join anyone for wolves. My kind of recruit.

Pus Pus.lastSaid: The shop was down, with feeling.
Pus Pus.note: Gnome. Tells jokes to other gnomes. Reports outages.

Anthéor Stonehymn.lastSaid: Declined to log out for the quest reward.
Anthéor Stonehymn.note: Dwarf. Knows what being a dwarf is about. Waited on a fire that owed him.

Embertempest Anvilmar.lastSaid: The campfire quest wouldn't pay out.
Embertempest Anvilmar.note: Dwarf. Smiled at a campfire that owed them a reward.

Náin Snowholdt.lastSaid: Suggested logging out and back in, out of character.
Náin Snowholdt.note: Dwarf. Wanted wolves early. Offers practical advice, out of character.

posts.title: Launch day
posts.text: Doors opened early. Coldridge Valley is wall-to-wall dwarves and gnomes, all shouting. Nothing's exploded yet. Give it a week.
posts.detail: Couldn't swing a dead cat without hitting a dwarf. Somebody else said that first.

posts.title: Coldridge roll call
posts.text: Coldridge Valley, wall to wall. Emmitt Brown, a gnome, found everyone tall. Frizzle Cinderspark, also a gnome, found it a family reunion. I asked nobody anything yet.
posts.detail: Fodrin Firebrand danced. Bargash Greybeard shouted for the forge and king. Brother Borelgore could not find Phil. Doldrenn Stoneforge went off wolf-killing with Náin Snowholdt. Pus Pus reported the shop down.
posts.alt: Coldridge Valley on launch night, seen through three setup windows that would not close.

posts.title: Two to six
posts.text: Level six before the first pint. Wolves, troggs, a troll cave, two mail runs. Picked up skinning and mining because the mountain was offering.
posts.detail: The mornbrew went cold on the first delivery and had to go again. The earth sapta wouldn't turn in, twice. I was already carrying one. An engineer's mistake, not a shaman's.
posts.alt: Level six, in the snow, with a wolf and two troggs waiting their turn.

posts.title: The campfire
posts.text: Sat by Eric Brighthammer's fire with three dwarves. Anthéor Stonehymn said this was the whole point of being a dwarf. He's not wrong.
posts.detail: The fire paid me and wouldn't pay them. Embertempest Anvilmar and Anthéor were still waiting when I stood up. Náin Snowholdt suggested leaving and coming back. Anthéor declined.

posts.title: A guild, apparently
posts.text: Set my hearth at Thunderbrew Distillery, which tells you my priorities. Six minutes on, a human called Malachi Zerbe asked me into The Brave of Lordaeron. Said yes.
posts.detail: Hadn't said a word all night and still got invited. Either a good sign about them or a bad one about the night. The hall was loud within the minute. Humans, mostly, from the sound of it.

posts.title: Died once
posts.text: Cheered for a lost gnome at fourteen past. Dead by fifteen past. Unrelated, as far as the gnome knows.
posts.detail: Ten percent off the gear. Walked back, finished Flintfire's shipment, then learned to cook boar ribs in beer, which is the first sensible thing anyone's taught me here.

posts.title: First night
posts.text: First night and I didn't say a word out loud. Twelve people talked near me and I listened, which you'd call progress and I'd call the cold.
posts.detail: Nobody asked where I'm from. Nobody will, in a valley this full of dwarves. Set my hearth at a distillery, joined a guild of humans with a brave name, died once in the snow and minded the walk more. The malt they gave me for a delivery is still in the pack. Haven't decided who to open it with.
